turns.query: From the Central air quality monitoring station, classify all other air quality monitoring stations into four quadrants (NE/NW/SE/SW) based on their relative latitude and longitude. How many stations fall into each quadrant?
code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

query = text("""
SELECT
  id,
  name_en,
  ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) AS latitude,
  ST_X(coordinate::geometry) AS longitude
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 16 OR id <> 16
""")
stations = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

ref = stations.loc[stations["name_en"] == "Central"].iloc[0]
others = stations[stations["name_en"] != "Central"].copy()

others["quadrant"] = others.apply(
    lambda r: "NE" if r["latitude"] > ref["latitude"] and r["longitude"] > ref["longitude"] else
              "NW" if r["latitude"] > ref["latitude"] and r["longitude"] < ref["longitude"] else
              "SE" if r["latitude"] < ref["latitude"] and r["longitude"] > ref["longitude"] else
              "SW" if r["latitude"] < ref["latitude"] and r["longitude"] < ref["longitude"] else
              "AXIS",
    axis=1
)

counts = others["quadrant"].value_counts().to_dict()
ne_count = int(counts.get("NE", 0))
nw_count = int(counts.get("NW", 0))
se_count = int(counts.get("SE", 0))
sw_count = int(counts.get("SW", 0))

print({
    "reference_station": "Central",
    "other_stations_total": int(len(others)),
    "ne_count": ne_count,
    "nw_count": nw_count,
    "se_count": se_count,
    "sw_count": sw_count,
    "axis_count": int(counts.get("AXIS", 0))
})
